item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 27/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will bring a few rain patches to the northern part of the South China Sea. The monsoon is expected to be replaced by a fresh to strong easterly airstream later tomorrow. It will be windy over the coast of Guangdong in the following couple of days. A replenishment of the monsoon will affect southern China over the weekend. Besides, the broad area of low pressure near the Philippines will move across the southern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow, towards Vietnam.
